<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>HR Resourse</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
  try {
    // Only HR agent/admin can call API
    if (!(gs.hasRole('x_884051_acl_sec_0.agent') || gs.hasRole('x_884051_acl_sec_0.admin'))) {
      response.setStatus(403);
      response.setBody({ error: 'Forbidden: HR agent/admin role required' });
      return;
    }

    var body = request.body.data || {};
    if (!body.title) {
      response.setStatus(400);
      response.setBody({ error: 'title is required' });
      return;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_884051_acl_sec_0_u_sensitive_request');
    gr.initialize();
    gr.u_title = body.title;
    gr.u_description = body.description || '';
    gr.u_requested_for = body.requested_for || gs.getUserID();
    gr.u_owner = body.owner || gs.getUserID();

    // Only allow admin to set SSN last4 via API
    if (body.ssn_last4 && gs.hasRole('x_884051_acl_sec_0.admin')) {
      gr.u_ssn_last4 = body.ssn_last4;
    }

    var sysId = gr.insert();

    response.setStatus(201);
    response.setBody({ message: 'Created', sys_id: sysId, number: gr.getValue('sys_id') });

  } catch (e) {
    response.setStatus(500);
    response.setBody({ error: e.message });
  }
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_884051_acl_sec_0/hr_confidential_request_api/create</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/create</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-27 18:07:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>e0cee36e3b49cf507cf65c0f23e45a5b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HR Resourse</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ACL Security Lite " source="x_884051_acl_sec_0">c7ad03ae3b45cf507cf65c0f23e45a4e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ACL Security Lite ">c7ad03ae3b45cf507cf65c0f23e45a4e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_e0cee36e3b49cf507cf65c0f23e45a5b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-27 18:07:44</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="HR Confidential Request API">5d2e232e3b49cf507cf65c0f23e45a62</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
